title: Google\Cloud\PubSub\V1\RetryPolicy
name: RetryPolicy
description: A policy that specifies how Cloud Pub/Sub retries message delivery.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.minimum_backoff
params.description: The minimum delay between consecutive deliveries of a given message. Value should be between 0 and 600 seconds. Defaults to 10 seconds.

params.name: data.maximum_backoff
params.description: The maximum delay between consecutive deliveries of a given message. Value should be between 0 and 600 seconds. Defaults to 600 seconds.

methods.name: getMinimumBackoff
methods.description: The minimum delay between consecutive deliveries of a given message.

methods.name: setMinimumBackoff
methods.description: The minimum delay between consecutive deliveries of a given message.

methods.name: getMaximumBackoff
methods.description: The maximum delay between consecutive deliveries of a given message.

methods.name: setMaximumBackoff
methods.description: The maximum delay between consecutive deliveries of a given message.
